# Shot List

## shot_01_hook
- Time: 0-3s
- Scene: Strong hook
- Visual: A creator struggles with a regular drone setup using both a phone and a controller, connection feels annoying and clumsy, then glances at the camera like this is too much work.
- Subtitle: Still using your phone?
- Voiceover: Still using your phone just to fly a drone?
- Purpose: Pattern interrupt and pain-point hook

## shot_02_remote
- Time: 3-6s
- Scene: Product reveal
- Visual: Fast reveal of the foldable drone and the built-in screen remote, remote display turns on and feels premium for an entry-level kit.
- Subtitle: Built-in screen remote
- Voiceover: This one has a built-in screen remote.
- Purpose: Show the differentiating feature fast

## shot_03_no_phone
- Time: 6-9s
- Scene: No phone workflow
- Visual: Hands hold the screen remote only, no phone mount, no app setup, live view already visible on the remote screen.
- Subtitle: No phone needed
- Voiceover: No phone holder. No app setup. Just turn it on and fly.
- Purpose: Remove friction for beginners

## shot_04_takeoff
- Time: 9-12s
- Scene: One-click takeoff
- Visual: Finger presses the takeoff button on the remote, drone lifts off cleanly from a flat surface in a satisfying motion.
- Subtitle: One-click takeoff
- Voiceover: One button takeoff makes it way easier for beginners.
- Purpose: Show simple control

## shot_05_hover
- Time: 12-15s
- Scene: Stable hovering
- Visual: Drone hovers smoothly indoors or in a calm outdoor spot, beginner-friendly energy, stable and controlled.
- Subtitle: Stable hovering
- Voiceover: It hovers smoothly, so beginners do not panic on the first flight.
- Purpose: Build confidence

## shot_06_dual_camera
- Time: 15-18s
- Scene: Dual camera switching
- Visual: Close-up on the drone camera module with a quick switch effect between front and lower camera angles, tied to remote control action.
- Subtitle: Dual camera switching
- Voiceover: You can switch camera angles right from the remote.
- Purpose: Show flexible viewing angles

## shot_07_accessories
- Time: 18-21s
- Scene: Full kit flat lay
- Visual: Top-down layout of the drone, screen remote, extra batteries, propellers, SD card, and carry case, clean ecommerce table setup.
- Subtitle: Ready-to-fly kit
- Voiceover: You get the drone, screen remote, extra batteries, propellers, SD card, and carry case.
- Purpose: Increase perceived value

## shot_08_lifestyle_cta
- Time: 21-30s
- Scene: Lifestyle + CTA
- Visual: Outdoor lifestyle shots of a beginner carrying the drone kit, preparing to fly, then final hero shot with remote and accessories together, clean TikTok Shop style close.
- Subtitle: Great first drone
Tap to check it out
- Voiceover: For travel, backyard flying, gifts, or just learning how drones work. If you want a simple first drone, this is the one I'd check out.
- Purpose: Show use cases and close with purchase intent
